notice: P4 anonymous testing only. Documents and rules are QA mechanics, not approved Honeyhold law or named story characters.
training_rules: QA-R1: An entry pass must remain valid on the current training day.
QA-R2: The pass holder and identification record must agree.
QA-R3: A minor travelling with an adult needs verifiable authorization.
QA-R4: Incomplete identity or guardian evidence may be placed on hold.
QA-R5: A registry-confirmed extension is accepted as an exception in this test.
